title: langgraph-checkpoint==4.3.0
summary: Changes since checkpoint==4.2.0 fix(checkpoint): default InMemorySaver delta history to the latest checkpoint ( #9257 ) test(checkpoint): run the delta conformance suite against InMemorySaver in CI ( #9261 ) fix(checkpoint,checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): validate namespace labels before store dispatch ( #9217 ) fix(checkpoint): keep serialized data when an object can't be rebuilt ( #9251 ) fix(langgraph): rep
body:
Changes since checkpoint==4.2.0

- fix(checkpoint): default InMemorySaver delta history to the latest checkpoint ( #9257 )

- test(checkpoint): run the delta conformance suite against InMemorySaver in CI ( #9261 )

- fix(checkpoint,checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): validate namespace labels before store dispatch ( #9217 )

- fix(checkpoint): keep serialized data when an object can't be rebuilt ( #9251 )

- fix(langgraph): replay a resumed exit-mode run's delta writes in live order ( #9114 )

- fix: order delta channel replay by task path ( #8544 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint with 4 updates ( #9148 )

- chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /libs/checkpoint ( #9131 )

- chore(deps): bump anyio from 4.12.1 to 4.14.2 in /libs/checkpoint ( #8995 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint with 4 updates ( #8777 )

- fix(checkpoint): widen Store put value type to Mapping[str, Any] ( #8617 )
summaryZh: langgraph-checkpoint发布4.3.0版本。本次更新默认将InMemorySaver delta历史记录指向最新检查点，并在CI中增加了一致性测试套件。同时，新版本对Postgres与SQLite检查点后端的命名空间标签进行了预先校验，并优化了反序列化失败时的数据保留策略。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph状态检查点持久化模块发布常规升级，改进了内存历史记录与命名空间校验。
